description:
PaperAgent prints and mails physical letters to US addresses through USPS. Prepare a letter in ChatGPT, validate the recipient’s address, and review a PDF preview and the exact total before approving your order.
Choose Standard or Certified Mail, complete payment through secure external checkout, and check your letter’s mailing status. Each letter includes up to three black-and-white pages. Certified Mail includes USPS tracking and delivery confirmation.
A PaperAgent account and payment are required to mail a letter. Letters may be reviewed before mailing.

We sell individual physical printed letters mailed in envelopes through USPS. Each letter contains up to three black-and-white pages. The price includes printing and postage. We do not sell digital goods or subscriptions.
